description: This file defines the SystemInfo class and related nested classes within the Thunder::PluginHost namespace. It manages system information such as identifiers, internet, security, location, time, and provisioning, providing interfaces for setting, getting, and notifying changes in system subsystem states.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Manages and provides access to various system subsystems such as identifier, internet, security, location, time, and provisioning, with capabilities to register/unregister notifications and update subsystem states.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Id
classes.description: Represents the system identifier, allowing setting and retrieving device-specific identification data.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Provisioning
classes.description: Handles provisioning information, including storage labels.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Internet
classes.description: Provides internet connectivity details such as IP address and network type.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Location
classes.description: Stores geographic location data including timezone, country, region, city, latitude, and longitude.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Set
methods.description: Sets the state of a specified subsystem with provided information, potentially triggering notifications.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Unset
methods.description: Removes the active state of a specified subsystem.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Get
methods.description: Retrieves the current information object for a specified subsystem.

methods.name: SystemInfo::IsActive
methods.description: Checks if a subsystem is currently active.
